claims.claim_text: The final closure is derived by recomputation over exact bound evidence and authority activates only through successful atomic publication.
claims.decision_rule: CLOSED only after every pre-activation property is recomputed and the prevalidated terminal payload is atomically published.
claims.failure_rule: NOT_CLOSED when any evidence, temporal, persistence, package, staging, or publication property is absent or unverifiable.
claims.not_applicable_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE is forbidden for required closure controls.
